arxiv-2006-09611.title: Learning a Functional Control for High-Frequency Finance
arxiv-2006-09611.creator: L. LEAL, † M. LAURIERE, † C.-A. LEHALLE ‡
arxiv-2006-09611.description: Abstract We use a deep neural network to generate controllers for optimal trading on high frequency data. For the first time, a neural network learns the mapping between the preferences of the trader, i.e. risk aversion parameters, and the optimal controls.

arxiv-2011-01787.title: Predicting intubation support requirement of patients using Chest X-ray with Deep Representation Learning
arxiv-2011-01787.creator: Maurya, Aniket
arxiv-2011-01787.description: Abstract Recent developments in medical imaging with Deep Learning presents an evidence of automated diagnosis and prognosis. It can also be a complement to currently available diagnosis methods. Deep Learning can be leveraged for diagnosis, severity prediction, intubation support prediction and many similar tasks.

arxiv-2301-01668.title: CONSTRUCTION OF STORAGE CODES OF RATE APPROACHING ONE ON TRIANGLE-FREE GRAPHS
arxiv-2301-01668.creator: Hexiang Huang Qing Xiang
arxiv-2301-01668.description: Abstract Consider an assignment of bits to the vertices of a connected graph Γ ⁡ ( V , E ) \Gamma(V,E) with the property that the value of each vertex is a function of the values of its neighbors. A collection of such assignments is called a storage code of length | V | |V| on Γ \Gamma .

arxiv-2301-12901.title: Simulating Integration of Urban Air Mobility into Existing Transportation Systems: A Survey
arxiv-2301-12901.creator: Xuan Jiang and Yuhan Tang and Junzhe Cao, Vishwanath Bulusu, Ph.D, Hao (Frank) Yang, Ph.D, Xin Peng, Ph.D, Yunhan Zheng, Ph.D and Jinhua Zhao, Ph.D, Raja Sengupta, Ph.D
arxiv-2301-12901.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Xuan Jiang and Yuhan Tang and Junzhe Cao, Vishwanath Bulusu, Ph.D, Hao (Frank) Yang, Ph.D, Xin Peng, Ph.D, Yunhan Zheng, Ph.D and Jinhua Zhao, Ph.D, Raja Sengupta, Ph.D. 1 Introduction U rbanization projects indicate that by 2050, more than 70% Europeans and 80% North Americans will call cities home.

arxiv-2309-14756.title: On quantifying and improving realism of images generated with diffusion
arxiv-2309-14756.creator: Yunzhuo Chen, Naveed Akhtar, Nur Al Hasan Haldar, Ajmal Mian The University of Western Australia, Perth, Australia
arxiv-2309-14756.description: Abstract Recent advances in diffusion models have led to a quantum leap in the quality of generative visual content. However, quantification of realism of the content is still challenging. Existing evaluation metrics, such as Inception Score and Fréchet inception distance, fall short on benchmarking diffusion models due to the versatility of the generated images.

arxiv-2405-02514.title: Helical close-packing of anisotropic tubes
arxiv-2405-02514.creator: Benjamin R. Greenvall & Gregory M. Grason
arxiv-2405-02514.description: Abstract Helically close-packed states of filaments are common in natural and engineered material systems, ranging from nanoscopic biomolecules to macroscopic structural components. While the simplest models of helical close-packing, described by the ideal rope model , neglect anisotropy perpendicular to the backbone, physical filaments are often quite far from circular in their cross-section.

arxiv-2410-05632.title: Topological properties of black holes in five-dimensional gauged supergravity
arxiv-2410-05632.creator: Yucheng He, Changxiang Lei, Deyou Chen
arxiv-2410-05632.description: Abstract In this paper, we study the topological properties of five-dimensional rotating charged black holes in different ensembles.The topological numbers for the black holes are gotten in the grand canonical and canonical ensembles, which are 1. When the charge and cosmological constant disappear, their topological numbers are 0.

arxiv-2412-05476.title: Digging for Decision Trees: A Case Study in Strategy Sampling and Learning
arxiv-2412-05476.creator: Carlos E. Budde, Pedro R. D’Argenio, Arnd Hartmanns
arxiv-2412-05476.description: Abstract We introduce a formal model of transportation in an open-pit mine for the purpose of optimising the mine’s operations. The model is a network of Markov automata (MA); the optimisation goal corresponds to maximising a time-bounded expected reward property. Today’s model checking algorithms exacerbate the state space explosion problem by applying a discretisation approach to such properties on MA.

arxiv-2512-13715.title: Meta-Hierarchical Reinforcement Learning for Scalable Resource Management in O-RAN
arxiv-2512-13715.creator: F. Lotfi 1 , F. Afghah 1
arxiv-2512-13715.description: Abstract The increasing complexity of modern applications demands wireless networks capable of real-time adaptability and efficient resource management. The Open Radio Access Network (O-RAN) architecture, with its RAN Intelligent Controller (RIC) modules, has emerged as a pivotal solution for dynamic resource management and network slicing.

arxiv-2603-16955.title: Comprehensive VLBI observations of Galileo satellites with the AuScope array
arxiv-2603-16955.creator: David Schunck, Lucia McCallum, Jamie McCallum, Tiege McCarthy

lowell-vision-sir-launfal-1848.title: The Vision of Sir Launfal
lowell-vision-sir-launfal-1848.creator: James Russell Lowell
lowell-vision-sir-launfal-1848.description: The Grail quest as moral allegory, containing 'The Present Crisis' — the poem that gave abolitionism its battle-cry.

pmc-10507689.title: Effect of individualized positive end-expiratory pressure based on electrical impedance tomography guidance on pulmonary ventilation distribution in patients who receive abdominal thermal perfusion chemotherapy
pmc-10507689.creator: Li Xiao, Kang Yu, Jiao-Jiao Yang, Wen-Tao Liu, Lei Liu, Hui-Hui Miao, Tian-Zuo Li
pmc-10507689.description: BackgroundElectrical impedance tomography (EIT) has been shown to be useful in guiding individual positive end-expiratory pressure titration for patients with mechanical ventilation. However, the appropriate positive end-expiratory pressure (PEEP) level and whether the individualized PEEP needs to be adjusted during long-term surgery (>6 h) were unknown.

pmc-10542596.title: A Monte Carlo simulation study comparing the up and down, biased-coin up and down and continual reassessment methods used to estimate an effective dose (ED95 or ED90) in anaesthesiology research
pmc-10542596.creator: Jean-François Fils, Panayota Kapessidou, Philippe Van der Linden, Emmanuel Guntz
pmc-10542596.description: BackgroundDose-finding studies in anaesthesiology aim to target the effective dose (ED) of an anaesthetic agent in a specific population. The common dose-finding designs used are the up and down method (UDM), the biased-coin up and down (BCD), and the continual reassessment method (CRM).

pmc-10627053.title: Postprocedural Disorders of Eye and Adnexa Admissions Profile
pmc-10627053.creator: Mohammad R Naqeeb, Abdallah Y Naser
pmc-10627053.description: PurposeThe aim of this study was to examine hospitalisation profiles related to postprocedural disorders of eye and adnexa in England and Wales.Patients and MethodsThis was an ecological study using publicly available data extracted from the “Hospital Episode Statistics (HES) database” in England and the “Patient Episode Database for Wales (PEDW)” for the period between April 1999 and April 2020.

pmc-11418478.title: Frailty is independently associated with subclinical cardiovascular disease in patients with systemic lupus erythematosus
pmc-11418478.creator: Maria Pappa, Kyriaki Keramiotou, Petros P Sfikakis, Maria G Tektonidou
pmc-11418478.description: ObjectivesCardiovascular disease is a leading cause of mortality in systemic lupus erythematosus (SLE). Frailty has been associated with an increased cardiovascular disease risk (CVR) in the general population. We aimed to examine the association between frailty and subclinical cardiovascular disease in patients with SLE.

pmc-11473778.title: Redox-mediated decoupled seawater direct splitting for H2 production
pmc-11473778.creator: Tao Liu, Cheng Lan, Min Tang, Mengxin Li, Yitao Xu, Hangrui Yang, Qingyue Deng, Wenchuan Jiang, Zhiyu Zhao, Yifan Wu, Heping Xie
pmc-11473778.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). Seawater direct electrolysis (SDE) using renewable energy provides a sustainable pathway to harness abundant oceanic hydrogen resources. However, the side-reaction of the chlorine electro-oxidation reaction (ClOR) severely decreased direct electrolysis efficiency of seawater and gradually corrodes the anode. In this study, a redox-mediated strategy is introduced to suppress the ClOR, and a decoupled seawater direct electrolysis (DSDE) system incorporating a separate O2 evolution reactor is established.

pmc-11747725.title: Gastric partitioning versus gastrojejunostomy for gastric outlet obstruction due to unresectable gastric cancer: randomized clinical trial
pmc-11747725.creator: Marcus Fernando Kodama Pertille Ramos, Marina Alessandra Pereira, André Roncon Dias, Osmar Kenji Yagi, Bruno Zilberstein, Ulysses Ribeiro-Junior
pmc-11747725.description: BackgroundGastric outlet obstruction due to unresectable tumours is usually managed with a gastrojejunostomy. Unfortunately, the unsatisfactory outcomes of this procedure have led to the search for alternatives, including gastric partitioning.MethodsMonocentric, randomized, parallel, open-label trial that included patients with obstructive, unresectable distal gastric tumours.

pmc-12541850.title: Tumor immune microenvironment analysis in different pathologic responses to neoadjuvant immunotherapy combined with chemotherapy in non-small cell lung cancer
pmc-12541850.creator: Zhaofeng Wang, Yunchang Meng, Fang Zhang, Ping Zhan, Tangfeng Lv, Yong Song, Hongbing Liu
pmc-12541850.description: BackgroundLung cancer, particularly non-small cell lung cancer (NSCLC), remains a major global challenge. Neoadjuvant immunotherapy combined with chemotherapy (IO-CT) has shown potential in improving survival outcomes for resectable NSCLC. This study aimed to investigate changes in the tumor immune microenvironment (TIME) following IO-CT or chemotherapy alone and identify immune biomarkers predictive of treatment response.

pmc-12553567.title: Genetically encoded fluorescent probes to assist in the diagnosis of small cell lung cancer
pmc-12553567.creator: Dengyue Xu, Hong Yuan, Zhi Li, Qingyun Jiang, Angyang Shang, Jiaqi Liu, Chengyu Xue, Shuai Shao, Hangyu Zhang, Bin Wu, Bo Liu
pmc-12553567.description: AbstractSmall cell lung cancer (SCLC) is one of the most aggressive malignancies, with early detection being crucial for improving patient outcomes. Serum biomarkers, neuron-specific enolase (NSE), and pro-gastrin releasing peptide (ProGRP), play significant roles in the early screening and pathological classification of SCLC.

pmc-12722183.title: Determining the Effective Dose of Oliceridine Compounded with Propofol for Painless Hysteroscopy: A Prospective Modified Dixon Sequential Dose-Finding Study
pmc-12722183.creator: Ke Yang, Qian Yuan, Hao Huang, Lina Wang, Jingyu You, Qiaojie Liu, Yulin Zhou, Yi Luo, Qin Liu
pmc-12722183.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). BackgroundOliceridine combined with propofol is suitable for intravenous anesthesia in painless hysteroscopy. This study aimed to determine the 50% effective dose (ED50) and 95% effective dose (ED95) of oliceridine compounded with propofol for painless hysteroscopy.MethodsIn all, 29 patients aged 18–60 years who were scheduled for painless hysteroscopy under intravenous anesthesia were recruited, and a total of 26 patients were enrolled in the final analysis.

pmc-13238605.title: Insights into a long life without cancer: The case of the bowhead whale
pmc-13238605.creator: Inés Paniagua, Johanna A. Joyce
pmc-13238605.description: Long‐lived and large‐bodied organisms face an inherent challenge: The more cells they contain and the longer they live, the greater the cumulative risk of acquiring mutations that can drive cancer. Yet, paradoxically, cancer incidence does not always scale with size or lifespan—a phenomenon known as Peto's paradox.

pmc-13260312.title: Incidence, Temporal Trends, and Surgical Shift of Achilles Tendon Rupture: A Systematic Review and Meta-analysis
pmc-13260312.creator: Roula Kotsifaki, Peter Malliaras, Christopher Byron, Joao Marques, Vasileios Korakakis
pmc-13260312.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). BackgroundAchilles tendon rupture is a severe injury affecting active and non-active populations, with considerable consequences on mobility, return to sport, and long-term function. Population-based incidence estimates provide important information for public health policy and resource allocation.ObjectiveThis systematic review and meta-analysis aimed to estimate the global incidence of Achilles tendon rupture, evaluate temporal trends over six decades, and analyze subgroup differences by sex, age, region, and sport participation.

pmc-13341220.title: Multidisciplinary Management of Tracheal Perforation: A Case of Successful Reconstruction and Stenting
pmc-13341220.creator: Sofia Valdes‐Camacho, Regina M. Murillo‐Torres, Tatiana A. Rojas‐Zapata, Alejandra Yu Lee‐Mateus, Paola Gutierrez‐Gallegos, Bastien A. Valencia‐Sanchez, Elise Anderson, Kelly S. Robertson, Sebastian Fernandez‐Bussy, Jeffrey R. Janus, David Abia‐Trujillo
pmc-13341220.description: Airway perforation is a potentially lethal complication from tracheal or mediastinal malignancies that require complex management. Advanced thyroid cancer is known to have high morbidity, and patients with tracheal metastatic lesions are vulnerable to injury. Therapeutic management typically comprises a combination of surgical and nonoperative treatment modalities, whose adverse effects can lead to significant airway injury.

pmc-13376187.title: The effect of nurse care management on multimorbid patients’ hospital utilization: a comparative-controlled trial and an exploratory cohort study
pmc-13376187.creator: Efrat Shadmi, Orly Tonkikh, Marcelo Low, Calanit Key, Doron Netzer, Tchiya Molcho, Shmuel Giveon, Chad Boult, Ran D Balicer
pmc-13376187.description: Multimorbidity, defined as the presence of two or more chronic conditions in one individual, poses substantial challenges to patients and healthcare systems, yet evidence regarding effective primary care interventions remains limited. We report on a two-year comparative controlled trial aimed to assess the effects of the nurse-led Comprehensive Care for Multimorbid Adults Program (CC-MAP), on patient outcomes.

pmc-13592954.title: Estimated prevalence of osteoporosis in postmenopausal women in Saudi Arabia
pmc-13592954.creator: Noor A. Hakim, Khulood S. Hussein
pmc-13592954.description: Although osteoporosis is a major public health concern, limited and outdated research in Saudi Arabia highlights the need to investigate its current prevalence and risk factors among postmenopausal women in Jeddah. This study aimed to determine the prevalence of osteoporosis in postmenopausal women in Saudi Arabia and identify factors associated with bone mineral density (BMD).
